vulnerability_summary: Taylored consumed purchase tokens with a non-atomic SELECT-then-UPDATE sequence, allowing concurrent replay.
causality: Google Jules bot commit 57b76343 introduced token_used_at, checked it after a SELECT, decrypted the patch, and only then issued a separate unconditional UPDATE by row id. Human fix fdf67a6f replaced the check-then-act sequence with one conditional UPDATE ... AND token_used_at IS NULL and gated delivery on this.changes. The AI-authored atomic commit directly created the race fixed by the advisory.

evidence.ai_binding: The atomic commit author is google-labs-jules[bot] and it adds both sides of the non-atomic token-consumption sequence.
